scope: Preliminary open-trench pressure-sewer construction estimate. Route length plus seven genuine project facts remain user-owned; geometry, materials, pipe balance, labor, mechanisms, testing and logistics are formula-derived from those facts and a visible replaceable engineering profile.
sourceAuthority: Visible preliminary canonical engineering profile requiring confirmation by the approved wastewater design, geotechnical report, pipe schedule and method statement
projectFactsRequired: selected pressure-pipe designation and outside diameter
project quantities of fittings, isolation valves, air valves and washout assemblies
formulaDerivedOutputs: bedding, surround, native and imported backfill and excess soil
pipe loss, spare, stock, supplier package order and remainder
pipe joints, chambers, covers and warning tape
labor, machine hours and delivery/removal trips

profilePolicy.presentation: Show as a grey in-field reference until the user explicitly confirms or replaces it
profilePolicy.confirmation: Every coefficient, productivity, designation and NOT_REQUIRED branch remains editable and requires project confirmation before contract use

forbiddenClaims: hydraulic diameter or pressure class selected from route length
fitting, valve, air-valve or washout quantities selected from generic spacing
conditional casing, dewatering or road restoration enabled without an explicit branch
preliminary profile presented as an approved universal norm
pumping station, gravity collector or building drainage included
